name: Yunmenglong
sum: Yunmenglong is a large somphospondylan sauropod from the late Early Cretaceous of Henan, China.
wsnote: Estimates of 20 m and 30 t (Paul 2016) and 27 m and 29 t (Molina-Perez and Larramendi 2020), as quoted in the Wikipedia revision.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted.
material: Known from the holotype from the Haoling Formation.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Lü et al. 2013
